request.system:

every claim in the sentence is stated in a quote or equals a provided computed value. Wording can differ; meaning
cannot. Anything extra, stronger, or interpretive is unsupported. Return only the tool call.
request.user:
SENTENCE: RPO grew by 44.83 percent year-over-year while revenue grew by 27.55 percent, indicating expanding forward visibility that is underappreciated by the market.
QUOTES: []
COMPUTED: ["s:S1: {\"fired\": true, \"inputs\": {\"consecutive\": 2, \"g_ob\": 0.4483, \"g_rev\": 0.2755, \"gap\": 0.1728}, \"kind\": \"signal\", \"strength\": \"0.82\"}"]
